facts.text: Fitch affirmed Poland's long-term foreign-currency IDR at 'A-' (A-/F1 FC and LC), Outlook Negative, on Friday 27 Feb after the close (scheduled after 22:00 CET; PAP/XYZ report timestamped 23:42). Drivers: large diversified economy, EU membership, credible monetary/FX policy, solid external finances vs high deficits, fast-rising debt, lower income/governance. Negative Outlook: persistently high deficits and rapid debt growth, no credible consolidation plan, political tensions. MoF summary of Fitch numbers: GG deficit 7.0% of GDP in 2025, 6.5% in 2026, 6.2% in 2027; GG debt ~59% of GDP in 2025 rising to ~70% in 2027; GDP 2025 3.6%, 2026 forecast raised to 3.6%, 2027 2.9%; military spending ~3% of GDP. Downgrade triggers: failure to stabilise debt, weaker growth, sharply higher financing costs.
